name: navbar
title: Navbar with responsive menu and account menu
description: A top navigation component: brand, links, a Menu button that shows the links on narrow screens and an Account disclosure list (aria-expanded, Escape closes and returns focus). views/_layout.brain renders it on every view (account items follow the session store); app.brain keeps only the document shell.
notes: Pass every view in `links` so each page stays linked. Uses plain disclosures instead of the kit <Menu>: <Menu>, <Table> and <Toast> currently fail `brain build` (B0116 on ui/ components with state).
